project_erasure: Project or tenant erasure is a separate lifecycle and may remove the complete project graph.

resources.retention: A conversation referenced by a commit is durable. An unreferenced conversation may be deleted.
resources.removal_gate: Not removable while Source Thread identity or repository Source Evidence is supported.

resources.retention: Turns are immutable source material and follow their conversation retention.
resources.removal_gate: Not removable while a retained conversation can resolve as source evidence.

resources.retention: Saved edits preserve the effective source text and follow their conversation retention.
resources.removal_gate: Not removable while turn-level source edits remain supported evidence.

resources.retention: Context selection follows its conversation. It is not commit evidence unless a Statement binds it explicitly.
resources.removal_gate: Not removable while server-owned Generation context uses source-thread selections.

resources.retention: Retain while compatibility writers or YOps rows can refer to topic identity.
resources.removal_gate: Stop writes after #1292, prove zero readers, then remove through an additive and rollback-documented migration.

resources.retention: Mutable draft projection only; commit history reads the immutable commit snapshot instead.
resources.removal_gate: Stop writers, prove zero readers, and verify CommitV1 history before any table removal.

resources.retention: Rows named by historical commits.yops_log_ids are immutable history. Uncommitted rows may be superseded or deleted; new CommitV2 does not create this linkage.
resources.removal_gate: No table removal until every supported CommitV1 projects its operations without this table.

resources.retention: CommitV1 rows are immutable archive history and evidence for an explicit CommitV2 State-import bridge. They are never promoted into synthetic CommitV2 parents.
resources.removal_gate: Retire every inventoried CommitV1 writer under #1305. Historical rows remain read-only and resolvable; project erasure remains separate.

resources.retention: Commit source descriptors are immutable provenance and remain readable for every supported CommitV1.
resources.removal_gate: New writes are retired by #1305. Historical values are not removable by feature retirement.

resources.retention: Historical Commit-to-YOps links are immutable and keep every referenced yops_log row durable. CommitV2 records Effects instead.
resources.removal_gate: New writes are retired by #1305. Historical links remain until the read-only CommitV1 archive no longer requires them.

resources.retention: Ordinary deletion must fail when either committed_as or an immutable commit source references the conversation.
resources.removal_gate: Permanent for ordinary feature deletion; project erasure remains separate.
